name: R&R BBQ (Pleasant Grove & Lehi, UT) Sliced Smoked Turkey Breast & Funeral Potatoes
searchKeywords: r and r bbq pleasant grove
whyItWorks: Juicy, hardwood-smoked turkey breast sliced thick with R&R's famous funeral potatoes (shredded potatoes baked in sour cream and cheddar). Comforting and rich in protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 1-Meat Plate with Smoked Turkey Breast and funeral potatoes (ask for sweet BBQ sauce on the side and skip raw pickles/onions).
watchOuts: Funeral potatoes contain dairy sour cream and cheddar
